method: Visual landmark readings from approved FRONT/BACK/LEFT SIDE/RIGHT SIDE sheets; authored dimensions below are a reconciled specification, not a claim of exact raster IoU or measured completion.

sourceObservations.soldier: Visible face I-V and closed slit only VI; shield fronts broad from front and narrow edge-on in profiles. Rank IV exposes metal breastplate while hands/calves remain cloth/leather; V-VI cover the underlying plate with one plain rank-colored frontal cloth tabard.
sourceObservations.archer: Hood is a broad pointed shell with an open beige face, narrow torso, split skirt, neutral lowered empty right hand. Bow left, quiver right-back, three arrows visible. Rank I has neither rear mantle nor leather vest; rank IV+ cape points extend near boot tops.

inferredHiddenConstruction.shieldGrip: One horizontal leather rear grip joined to two short anchors; placement is inferred where occluded by the hand.
inferredHiddenConstruction.helmetBack: One simple faceted steel shell attached to crown and lateral cheek volumes; no duplicated face or front breastplate.
inferredHiddenConstruction.quiver: One six-sided leather tube on outer right cape, mouth pointing up/right, bottom near right belt. Back strap attachment hidden below tube is inferred.
inferredHiddenConstruction.bowPlane: PNG front and both profiles show similarly broad bow curves, which cannot all be exact orthographic views of a single flat bow. A fixed diagonal plane with horizontal vector (-0.7071,+0.7071,0) is used; it is never rotated per camera. This is a disclosed reconciliation, not a guaranteed exact match.
inferredHiddenConstruction.weaponDepth: Tool depth and elbow height reconciled against profiles after native pilot overlay: Soldier right elbow (.335,.14,.970) and grip (.472,.45,.955); Archer left elbow (-.334,.15,.950) and bow grip (-.488,.52,.926). Forearms are nearly level as in the approved side sheets. Tool stays ahead of face by .20-.30 units. Same rigid geometry and physical pose in all cameras.
inferredHiddenConstruction.cape: One front-open U-shaped cloth shell, not a planar sheet. Side edges wrap forward to Y=.045 at the hem; short rear hemY=-.45, long rear hemY=-.54. Archer IV-VI have two broad lower tips with one center notch. Shoulder arc and hidden construction inferred from four silhouettes.
inferredHiddenConstruction.closedHelmFace: Soldier VI has one solid closed helmet. The fully occluded internal face and two eye meshes are omitted as a hidden-part optimization; visor remains one physical steel helmet with one black slit, and head/neck pivot contract stays intact. root extra occludedFaceOmitted=true records omission.
inferredHiddenConstruction.soldierHeadFit: Hair crown/front/back translated +.080Y and cheek inner edge moved to X=.123/.140,Y=.221; open helmets translated +.090Y and cheek inner edges X=.128/.132,Y=.267/.264 so both enclose the latest forward faceted face rather than leaving separated cheek strips.
inferredHiddenConstruction.frontTabard: Soldier V/VI retain the real steel breastplate under one rank-colored cloth front tabard at Y=.214-.228, shoulder topZ1.254, belt bottomZ.882. IV exposes its steel plate; V/VI front appearance follows the gold cloth area of the approved reference.

validationStatus: Initial authoring specification. Native renders and actual export checks still required.
